events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, dying six days later.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years since his tragic passing, we're remembering the undeniable impact of Tupac Shakur. Which of his tracks still gets you?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, aged just 27, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: 56 years ago, the music world lost a legend. Jimi Hendrix forever changed the sound of the guitar. What's your favourite Hendrix moment or track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From the iconic cover to the timeless tracks, what's your top pick from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and style are simply iconic. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: You know the drill. It's Liam Gallagher's 54th birthday! What's your favourite track from the man himself, whether Oasis or solo?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Released 51 Years Ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as it was then. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: The First iPod Launched 25 Years Ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: 25 years ago, the iPod dropped and changed music forever. Remember painstakingly curating your playlists? What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the best Bond theme tune? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember The Beatles' visionary, John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedy is truly timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece of diverse sounds. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away, aged 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived, marking a pivotal moment in their sound. What's your standout track from this classic?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years On
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic loss of John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years since the world lost John Lennon. His message of peace and love echoes on. What's the song that reminds you most of his legacy?
